svg.title: Data Bender — 14 HP VCV Rack faceplate
svg.desc: Vector reconstruction from the user-supplied 280 by 509 pixel photograph. 71.12 mm by 128.5 mm. Text and Qu-Bit mark are traced paths, not substituted fonts. Hardware is excluded from the faceplate; hidden component guides are provided. Personal reference only. Manufacturer artwork and marks remain the property of their respective owners. This is not a manufacturer-authorized vector master or a verified mechanical drawing.
